note: Parity gate for a future Kotlin onnxruntime-android port of student_int8.onnx. Windows here are 0.3 s (not the production 2 s) purely to keep this file under 300 KB; the model's global time-pooling makes any length numerically valid. Feed pcm_i16_base64 (little-endian int16) -> float32/32768.0 -> the model and expect these four outputs (arousal, valence, dominance, heat_prob = sigmoid(heat_logit)) within ~1e-3, the int8 quantisation tolerance.
